panels.description:
One row per merged pull request in the selected project(s) and time range, by merge date, newest first. Use it to trace bug-fix PRs back to the PRs that caused them and to compare AI-assisted with non-AI PRs.

- **Ticket** lists the PR's linked issues from `pull_request_issues` (written by the linker plugin and by GitHub's `closes #123` links) when it has any. Otherwise it is the first match of: a Jira-style key (`ABC-123`) in the title, then in the branch; a lowercase branch key (`abc-123`) whose prefix appears as an uppercase key in at least 3 of the repository's PRs; `#123` in the title or branch, ignoring PR references such as `(#123)`, `pull request #123`, `Revert #123`, `Backport #123` and `Follow-up to #123`; then a 4+ digit number between `/`, `_` or `-` in the branch name that isn't a date, a revert or backport PR number, or part of a number range. Technical terms such as `UTF-8`, `SHA-256`, `CVE-2024` and `HTTP-2` are skipped.
- **Approvers** are reviewers whose latest approve, request-changes or dismissed review is an approval, so an approval that was later withdrawn or dismissed isn't listed. GitHub reviews and GitLab approvals are recorded; Bitbucket and Bitbucket Server PRs show none. Deleted accounts show as *Unknown user*.
- **Files Changed** counts distinct file paths across the PR's single-parent commits, which include a squash or rebase merge result, so a file changed and then reverted inside the PR still counts. A two-parent merge commit is skipped. It needs commit file data from the git extractor (`SKIP_COMMIT_FILES=false`; the default is `true`) and shows *n/a* when none of the PR's commits have it. For rebase-merged PRs whose branch was deleted, only the last rebased commit is in the clone, so the count is low.
- **Claude Co-Authored** is Yes when any commit in the PR, or its merge commit, has a `Co-Authored-By:` line with `noreply@anthropic.com`. Commit messages come from the cloned repository and, for GitHub, from the PR commits the GitHub plugin collects, so squash- and rebase-merged PRs are still checked after their branch is deleted. *Unknown* means no commit message was found for the PR. Release and back-merge PRs carry every commit they promote, so they are Yes when any of those commits are.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prs AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id, pr.pull_request_key, pr.url, pr.title, pr.head_ref, pr.author_id, pr.author_name, pr.merged_date, pr.merge_commit_sha
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)))
    AND ('__all' IN ($repo_id) OR pr.base_repo_id IN ($repo_id))
    AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
    AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
),
linked AS (
  SELECT pri.pull_request_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT IF(pri.issue_key REGEXP '^[0-9]+$', CONCAT('#', pri.issue_key), pri.issue_key) ORDER BY pri.issue_key SEPARATOR ', ') AS ticket
  FROM pull_request_issues pri
  WHERE pri.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM prs) AND pri.issue_key <> ''
  GROUP BY pri.pull_request_id
),
known_prefixes AS (
  SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(k.issue_key, '-', 1) AS prefix
  FROM (
    SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.title, '(?<![[:alnum:]])(?!(?:UTF|SHA|CVE|HTTP|TLS|SSL|ISO|RFC|PEP|IPV|DNS|SPRINT|GPT|RELEASE|HOTFIX|STAGING|AUTO|PERF|PVT|VERSION)-)[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]{1,6}(?![0-9])', 1, 1, 'c') AS issue_key
    FROM pull_requests p WHERE p.base_repo_id IN (SELECT base_repo_id FROM prs)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.head_ref, '(?<![[:alnum:]])(?!(?:UTF|SHA|CVE|HTTP|TLS|SSL|ISO|RFC|PEP|IPV|DNS|SPRINT|GPT|RELEASE|HOTFIX|STAGING|AUTO|PERF|PVT|VERSION)-)[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]{1,6}(?![0-9])', 1, 1, 'c')
    FROM pull_requests p WHERE p.base_repo_id IN (SELECT base_repo_id FROM prs)
  ) k
  WHERE k.issue_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
branch_keys AS (
  SELECT b.id, b.issue_key
  FROM (
    SELECT b.id, b.issue_key, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.id ORDER BY b.n) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT prs.id, n.n, UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(prs.head_ref, '(?<![[:alnum:]])[a-z][a-z0-9]+-[0-9]{1,6}(?![0-9])', 1, n.n, 'i')) AS issue_key
      FROM prs CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) n
    ) b
    JOIN known_prefixes kp ON kp.prefix = SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.issue_key, '-', 1)
  ) b
  WHERE b.rn = 1
),
pr_commits AS (
  SELECT prc.pull_request_id, prc.commit_sha FROM pull_request_commits prc WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM prs)
  UNION
  SELECT id, merge_commit_sha FROM prs WHERE merge_commit_sha <> ''
),
claude AS (
  SELECT m.pull_request_id, SUM(m.claude) AS commits
  FROM (
    SELECT pc.pull_request_id, CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4) LIKE '%noreply@anthropic.com%' AND REGEXP_LIKE(CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4), 'co-authored-by:.*noreply@anthropic[.]com', 'i') AS claude
    FROM pr_commits pc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = pc.commit_sha
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pc.pull_request_id, gc.message LIKE '%noreply@anthropic.com%' AND REGEXP_LIKE(gc.message, 'co-authored-by:.*noreply@anthropic[.]com', 'i')
    FROM pr_commits pc JOIN _tool_github_commits gc ON gc.sha = pc.commit_sha
  ) m
  GROUP BY m.pull_request_id
),
file_commits AS (
  SELECT pc.pull_request_id, pc.commit_sha
  FROM pr_commits pc
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commit_files cf WHERE cf.commit_sha = pc.commit_sha)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = pc.commit_sha) <= 1
),
files AS (
  SELECT fc.pull_request_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.file_path) AS files
  FROM file_commits fc JOIN commit_files cf ON cf.commit_sha = fc.commit_sha
  GROUP BY fc.pull_request_id
),
latest_reviews AS (
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, c.account_id, c.status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.pull_request_id, c.account_id ORDER BY c.created_date DESC, c.id DESC) AS rn
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  WHERE c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'DISMISSED') AND c.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM prs)
),
approvers AS (
  SELECT lr.pull_request_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), 'Unknown user') ORDER BY 1 SEPARATOR ', ') AS names
  FROM latest_reviews lr LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = lr.account_id
  WHERE lr.rn = 1 AND lr.status = 'APPROVED'
  GROUP BY lr.pull_request_id
)
SELECT
  r.name AS "Repository",
  prs.pull_request_key AS "PR",
  prs.url AS "url",
  prs.title AS "Title",
  prs.head_ref AS "Branch",
  COALESCE(
    li.ticket,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(prs.title, '(?<![[:alnum:]])(?!(?:UTF|SHA|CVE|HTTP|TLS|SSL|ISO|RFC|PEP|IPV|DNS|SPRINT|GPT|RELEASE|HOTFIX|STAGING|AUTO|PERF|PVT|VERSION)-)[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]{1,6}(?![0-9])', 1, 1, 'c'),
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(prs.head_ref, '(?<![[:alnum:]])(?!(?:UTF|SHA|CVE|HTTP|TLS|SSL|ISO|RFC|PEP|IPV|DNS|SPRINT|GPT|RELEASE|HOTFIX|STAGING|AUTO|PERF|PVT|VERSION)-)[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]{1,6}(?![0-9])', 1, 1, 'c'),
    bk.issue_key,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(CONCAT_WS(' ', prs.title, prs.head_ref), '(?<![(]|request |revert |reverts |backport |backport of |follow-up to |follow up to |followup to |cherry-pick of |cherry pick of )#[0-9]+', 1, 1, 'i'),
    CONCAT('#', REGEXP_SUBSTR(prs.head_ref, '(?<![^/_-])(?<![0-9]-)(?<!revert-)(?<!backport-)(?<!pr-)(?!(?:19|20)[0-9]{2}(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])(?![0-9]))(?!(?:19|20)[0-9]{2}[_-](?:q[1-4]|jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec))[0-9]{4,}(?![^/_-]|-[0-9])', 1, 1, 'i'))
  ) AS "Ticket",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(au.full_name, ''), prs.author_name) AS "Author",
  prs.merged_date AS "Merged",
  ap.names AS "Approvers",
  f.files AS "Files Changed",
  CASE WHEN cl.pull_request_id IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN cl.commits > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Claude Co-Authored"
FROM prs
LEFT JOIN repos r ON r.id = prs.base_repo_id
LEFT JOIN accounts au ON au.id = prs.author_id
LEFT JOIN linked li ON li.pull_request_id = prs.id
LEFT JOIN branch_keys bk ON bk.id = prs.id
LEFT JOIN approvers ap ON ap.pull_request_id = prs.id
LEFT JOIN files f ON f.pull_request_id = prs.id
LEFT JOIN claude cl ON cl.pull_request_id = prs.id
ORDER BY prs.merged_date DESC

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;

INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'

list.definition:
WITH scoped_conn AS (
  SELECT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE c.status = 'active'
    AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
),
otel AS (
  SELECT user_email AS email FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity' AND user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
  UNION
  SELECT user_email FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
),
linked AS (
  SELECT o.email, MIN(g.author_id) AS gid
  FROM otel o
  JOIN _tool_github_commits g ON g.author_email = o.email AND g.author_id > 0
  GROUP BY o.email
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.author_id) = 1
),
pr_authors AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS gid, MAX(pr.author_name) AS login
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pm.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%[bot]'
    AND ($__timeFilter(pr.created_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date))
  GROUP BY 1
),
people AS (
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', l.gid) AS k, l.gid, MIN(l.email) AS email, NULL AS login, 1 AS has_ai FROM linked l GROUP BY l.gid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('em:', o.email), NULL, o.email, NULL, 1 FROM otel o WHERE o.email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM linked)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', p.gid), p.gid, NULL, p.login, 0 FROM pr_authors p WHERE p.gid NOT IN (SELECT gid FROM linked)
),
named AS (
  SELECT p.k, p.has_ai, COALESCE(ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS handle,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ga.name, ''), ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS name
  FROM people p
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(login) AS login, MAX(name) AS name FROM _tool_github_accounts GROUP BY id) ga ON ga.id = p.gid
)
SELECT CONCAT(
    name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND handle <> name THEN CONCAT(' (', handle, ')') ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN k LIKE 'em:%' THEN ' · no GitHub link' WHEN has_ai = 0 THEN ' · no AI data' ELSE '' END
  ) AS __text,
  k AS __value
FROM named
ORDER BY has_ai DESC, __text;
list.description: OTel developers in the selected projects and teams, plus GitHub authors of PRs in the selected projects. AI data matches on OTel email; PRs match on the GitHub account that GitHub links to that email through commits. Task and defect panels ignore this filter.
